scope_note: A comparison corpus, not an exhaustive census. Each entry was located by web search on the review date and its facts taken from the cited page. A dash in a capability column means the capability was not documented in the source reviewed; it is not a claim that the capability is absent.

legend.-: not documented in the source reviewed

entries.name: Google Maps Platform Air Quality API
entries.data: Not disclosed in the overview reviewed
entries.health: Recommendations for the general public and for children, elderly, pregnant women, athletes, and people with asthma or heart conditions
entries.performance: Not published in the source reviewed
entries.limitation: No uncertainty or confidence documented for forecasts; data sources and method undisclosed; recommendations are text keyed to index level; no stated guarantee on advisory error; closed.

entries.name: Google Air View+ (India)
entries.data: Sensor networks (Aurassure, Respirer Living Sciences), government data, satellite, weather, traffic, land cover
entries.health: Follows National AQI categorisation and guidance
entries.performance: Sensors validated with IIT Delhi, IIT Hyderabad, state boards, CSTEP
entries.limitation: Nowcast rather than next-day forecast in the sources reviewed; no cohort-specific guidance, uncertainty or explanation documented; closed.

entries.name: SAFAR-India (IITM / IMD)
entries.data: Dedicated monitoring network plus chemistry-transport modelling
entries.health: Health advisory and precautions keyed to AQI
entries.limitation: Four cities; advisory is generic by AQI level rather than by cohort; no uncertainty communicated.

entries.name: Air Quality Early Warning System, Delhi (Jena et al.)
entries.data: WRF-Chem with assimilation of satellite AOD, satellite fire emissions and in-situ aerosol observations
entries.performance: Reported to reduce biases in 72-h forecasts by 70-86%
entries.limitation: Delhi only; computationally heavy physical model; no personalised guidance; no uncertainty band for the public.

entries.name: Decision Support System v1.0, Delhi (Govardhan et al.)
entries.performance: Accuracy up to 80% and false-alarm ratio about 20% for AQI > 300, days 1-5
entries.limitation: Delhi only; scenarios are sector emission interventions, not translated into who is affected; no cohort or uncertainty layer.

entries.name: UrbanEmissions.info India air quality forecasts
entries.region: India, all districts; Delhi at 1 km
entries.data: Dynamic emission inventory, WRF meteorology driven by GFS
entries.limitation: Physical-model forecast without station-level statistical correction, cohort guidance or uncertainty in the sources reviewed.

entries.name: CPCB National AQI portal and Sameer app
entries.health: Health statements attached to each AQI category
entries.limitation: Describes the present, not tomorrow; one message for everyone in a category; the maximum sub-index discards the rest of the mixture.

entries.name: Graded Response Action Plan (CAQM)
entries.data: Observed AQI plus IMD/IITM meteorological and air quality forecasts
entries.limitation: Triggers on a single regional AQI threshold; no differentiation by vulnerable group; forecast uncertainty is not part of the stated trigger.

entries.name: US EPA AirNow and the Air Quality Flag Program
entries.health: Guidance for sensitive groups (lung disease, older adults, children, people active outdoors); school flag colours drive activity changes
entries.limitation: Two tiers only (everyone / sensitive groups); timing guidance is generic; no uncertainty shown.

entries.name: UK Daily Air Quality Index
entries.data: National network; forecasts by the Met Office
entries.health: Separate advice for the general population and for at-risk individuals (lung problems, heart problems, older people)
entries.limitation: Two tiers; advice keyed to band rather than to the pollutant mixture; no uncertainty shown.

entries.name: Air Quality Health Index, Canada (Stieb et al.)
entries.data: NO2, O3, PM2.5; daily mortality in Canadian cities
entries.model: Sum of excess mortality risk across pollutants, scaled 0-10
entries.performance: Each unit associated with a 1.2% mortality increase across 12 cities (1981-2000)
entries.limitation: Coefficients are Canadian; no cohort-specific weights; a framework to follow rather than a competitor.

entries.name: Hong Kong Air Quality Health Index
entries.data: Station network; index based on hospital-admission risk
entries.health: Precautionary advice for children, the elderly and people with heart or respiratory illness, separately from the general public
entries.limitation: Two tiers; no uncertainty; no scenario analysis.

entries.name: European Air Quality Index (EEA)
entries.health: Health messages for the general population and for sensitive groups
entries.limitation: Two tiers; not forecast-driven in the source reviewed.

entries.name: City-specific AQHI for Delhi and Varanasi (George et al.)
entries.data: PM2.5, NO2, O3 and daily mortality
entries.health: Excess mortality risk per AQI category (2% moderate to 16% severe)
entries.performance: 0.20% (Delhi) and 0.17% (Varanasi) mortality increase per 10 ug/m3 PM2.5
entries.limitation: Two cities; retrospective; no forecast, no cohort weights, no application. Shows a pooled index can misrepresent local risk.

entries.name: Forecaster.health (ISGlobal)
entries.data: Air quality forecasts, epidemiological models, mortality data
entries.model: Epidemiological exposure-response models applied to forecasts
entries.health: Mortality-risk alerts by sex and age group for PM2.5, PM10, NO2 and O3
entries.limitation: Europe only; groups are sex and age, not condition or occupation; no decision guarantee on warnings or scenario analysis documented. The closest conceptual prior art, and epidemiologically stronger than a hand-weighted index.

entries.name: IQAir AirVisual
entries.data: Government stations and IQAir validated sensors
entries.model: Described only as machine learning and AI
entries.performance: Not published in the source reviewed
entries.limitation: Method and accuracy undisclosed; no uncertainty; generic recommendations.

entries.name: Plume Labs Air Report
entries.health: Advice tailored to runners, cyclists, parents and outdoor dining
entries.performance: 73% of surveyed users reported changing habits
entries.limitation: Activity profiles rather than health-vulnerability cohorts; 24-h horizon; no uncertainty; method undisclosed.

entries.name: AQI.in
entries.data: Nearest ambient monitoring stations; weather and open-fire data
entries.limitation: No next-day forecast documented in the listing reviewed; no uncertainty or explanation.

entries.name: Ambee Air Quality API
entries.horizon: 48 h to 7 days (10 days on demand)
entries.limitation: Vendor-reported accuracy; no uncertainty, cohort guidance or explanation documented; closed.

entries.name: AirRater (Workman et al. evaluation)
entries.data: Near real-time air quality, pollen, temperature; personal symptom tracking
entries.performance: Interviews with 42 users: most reported the app supported protective decisions
entries.limitation: No forecast; evidence is qualitative. Useful as evidence that people with existing conditions act on such information.

entries.name: ECMWF CAMS global atmospheric composition (via Open-Meteo)
entries.data: Global chemistry-transport model with data assimilation
entries.performance: Verified responding on the review date for Chennai and Delhi
entries.limitation: About 45 km grid cannot resolve a city's hotspots; modelled, not measured. The benchmark any Indian statistical forecast must beat.

entries.name: Aurora foundation model (Bodnar et al.)
entries.data: Over a million hours of geophysical data
entries.performance: Reported to outperform operational air-pollution forecasts at far lower computational cost
entries.limitation: Grid-scale concentrations; no health layer, no decision layer; heavy to run.

entries.name: AirFormer (Liang et al.)
entries.model: Transformer with a stochastic latent stage
entries.performance: 5-8% lower error than prior models on 72-h prediction
entries.limitation: Needs a dense station graph; no health layer; uncertainty is modelled internally rather than calibrated for users.

entries.name: PM2.5-GNN (Wang et al.)
entries.data: Station data with meteorological domain knowledge
entries.limitation: Requires a multi-city graph and meteorology; no uncertainty or health layer.

entries.name: E-STGCN (Panja et al.)
entries.model: Graph convolution with extreme-value-guided LSTM; conformal prediction intervals
entries.performance: Consistent across seasons against temporal and spatiotemporal benchmarks
entries.limitation: One city; no health or decision layer; no unseen-city test. The closest Indian work on extremes with conformal intervals.

entries.name: Probabilistic deep learning to quantify uncertainty in air quality forecasting
entries.limitation: Uncertainty reported as a modelling result, not carried into a public advisory.

entries.name: Conformal prediction of air pollution concentrations, Barcelona Metropolitan Region
entries.limitation: Intervals without a decision or advisory layer.

entries.name: Cross-city transfer learning for Sentinel-5P NO2 (Janku et al.)
entries.performance: RMSE about 7% lower than city-specific baselines; Toronto R2 0.58 to 0.66
entries.limitation: Estimates concentrations rather than forecasting; five wealthy cities; shows leave-one-city-out is already an established protocol.

entries.name: Spatial transfer learning for estimating PM2.5 in data-poor regions
entries.limitation: Estimation at unseen locations rather than next-day advisory.

entries.name: Ambiguity and novelty rejection for time-series forecasting (Feng et al.)
entries.model: Error-variance ambiguity rejection plus VAE / Mahalanobis novelty rejection
entries.limitation: General method; does not examine which cases are rejected in a safety-critical advisory setting.

entries.name: Model-agnostic explainable selective regression via uncertainty estimation
entries.limitation: General method, not air quality.

entries.name: Conformal risk control (Angelopoulos et al.)
entries.model: Distribution-free control of an expected loss
entries.limitation: Guarantee assumes exchangeability, which a drifting pollution series violates; needs adaptation for time series.

entries.name: WHO AirQ+
entries.data: User-supplied concentrations, population and baseline health data
entries.health: Attributable cases, years of life lost
entries.limitation: Desktop assessment tool, not a forecast or advisory system.

entries.name: US EPA BenMAP-CE
entries.data: Air quality surfaces, demographics, health and economic data
entries.model: Exposure-response functions with built-in percentage roll-back of concentrations
entries.health: Mortality and morbidity avoided, with valuation
entries.limitation: Assessment tool; annual-scale outcomes; not connected to a daily forecast or advisory. Direct prior art for percentage-reduction scenarios.

entries.name: The value of air quality forecasting in the Mid-Atlantic region
entries.performance: Shows the most skilful forecast is not necessarily the most valuable
entries.limitation: One cost-loss ratio for all users; not cohort-specific; no distribution-free guarantee.

entries.name: The boy who cried wolf revisited (Roulston and Smith)
entries.performance: Optimal warning threshold shifts with users' tolerance of false alarms
entries.limitation: Theory; motivates measuring over-warning alongside under-warning.

entries.name: Random-forest meteorological normalisation (Grange et al.)
entries.limitation: Explains why an uncorrected before/after comparison cannot be read causally.

entries.name: COVID-19 lockdowns cause global air pollution declines (Venter et al.)
entries.performance: NO2 -60% (95% CI 48-72), PM2.5 -31% (95% CI 17-45) after accounting for meteorology
entries.limitation: The reference method for a lockdown effect; the present project's -34% is not weather-adjusted.

entries.name: Ambient air pollution and daily mortality in ten cities of India (de Bont et al.)
entries.data: Daily PM2.5 from a hybrid spatiotemporal model; daily mortality 2008-2019
entries.model: Poisson time series with instrumental-variable causal analysis
entries.health: 1.4% higher daily mortality per 10 ug/m3 (2-day mean); 3.6% in the causal analysis
entries.limitation: All-age mortality only; the Indian evidence base an advisory index should be anchored to.

entries.name: AirSense-X: physics-informed neural and explainable AQI prediction
entries.data: Public daily AQI dataset across Indian stations
entries.limitation: Headline accuracy near the level a same-day formulation produces by construction; no persistence baseline, uncertainty or unseen-city test in the summary reviewed.

entries.name: Forecasting and validating Delhi's AQI: a multi-model approach
entries.model: Linear, random forest, XGBoost with SHAP
entries.limitation: Single station; no weather; no uncertainty. An honest next-day result that shows how hard the task is without lag-rich features.

entries.name: Dual-branch explainable AI framework for AQI across Indian cities
entries.model: XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, linear; LSTM, GRU, TCN, Transformer; multi-level XAI
entries.performance: Rolling AQI averages identified as dominant predictors
entries.limitation: Model comparison with explanation; no health, uncertainty or decision layer in the summary reviewed.

entries.name: Student and open projects on the same Kaggle dataset
entries.model: Random forest, KNN, gradient boosting, LSTM
entries.performance: For example R2 0.88, MAE 23.7 at station level
entries.limitation: Commonly predict the same day's AQI from the pollutants that define it, with random splits and no persistence baseline.

entries.name: Instructor-worker LLM system for air-quality policy recommendation
entries.data: Cloud-hosted air quality data during the January 2025 wildfires
entries.health: LLM-generated daily health advisories compared against issued ones
entries.limitation: Generative advice without a calibrated forecast or an error guarantee.

entries.name: ESoWC air-quality bias correction of CAMS
entries.limitation: Establishes statistical post-processing of CAMS as a known technique; not India-specific.

entries.name: Machine learning for urban air quality analytics: a survey
entries.model: Review of temporal, spatiotemporal and attention models
entries.limitation: Confirms that forecasting architecture alone is a crowded field.

entries.name: CPCB continuous monitoring data for India, 2015-2019 (Princeton Data Commons)
entries.data: Hourly station observations of criteria pollutants
entries.limitation: Ends 2019; a station-level complement to the city-level file used today.

entries.name: AirGuard India 1.0 (this project, as deployed)
entries.model: LightGBM regression; LightGBM + SMOTE classification as deployed
entries.health: Seven-cohort Health Advisory Index with hand-set weights
entries.performance: MAE 15.05 against persistence 18.90; macro-F1 0.7145 as deployed
entries.limitation: Not live; no weather; no interval; deployed confidence is miscalibrated; index saturates on bad days; advisory weights unvalidated.
